questions_and_answers.question: Artwork: What do you think is the political aspect of art?
questions_and_answers.answer: It's interesting that I was asked to answer this question. Don't know if you know this but I am the person responsible for generating the following image in 2004: which you can read about here: War President [ http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/War_President ] So I've thought a lot about political art over the years. Generally, one's definition of the political aspect of art depends on what one believes is the purpose of art. Its political aspect is then just that purpose projected into the domain of politics. Personally, I believe that art is for many things but the main thing is that it is an attempt to communicate thoughts and feelings that are beyond the reach of natural language. So something like "Guernica", to me, is expressing something about the nature of war, something that one couldn't simply write down with words.
